entities.name: Asha
entities.description: A figure who left Bant after ensuring the world would have protection and order in her absence.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A world (shard) protected and ordered in Asha's absence, home of an orchardist named Pulan.

entities.name: Josuri
entities.description: A speaker who describes an ancient rising from the night sky.

entities.name: Miotri
entities.description: An auratouched mage who counsels on the choice of three dreams.

entities.name: Reith
entities.description: A master illusionist who speaks of an angel made of pure belief.

entities.name: Ambassador Laquatus
entities.description: An ambassador who disregards his enemy's hopes.

entities.name: Lumi
entities.description: A goatherd pleased by a frost clearing the pasture.

entities.name: Yurin
entities.description: A royal assassin who says wars are won with a single knife blade.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who prizes minions that know her needs unspoken.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: A teacher who gave a lesson on raw elemental magic to two wide-eyed brothers.

entities.name: Snukk
entities.description: A goblin who vowed halfway to the target of a fling that he had been tricked for the last time.

entities.name: Edra
entities.description: A merfolk sovereign who finds her trusted advisors gone.

entities.name: Benzir
entities.description: The archdruid of Temple Might.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A speaker who says artifice has stood upon nature's shoulders.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: A ruler who commands armies, served by the Glen Elendra Liege.

entities.name: Krond the Dawn-Clad
entities.description: The personification of the dawn's light, who lives to exact justice on his nemesis Vela.

entities.name: Vela the Night-Clad
entities.description: Nemesis of Krond who snuffs out every trace of his reign, leaving nightfall.

entities.name: Pulan
entities.description: A Bant orchardist whose trees were transformed.

entities.name: Hildin
entities.description: A priest of Avacyn.

entities.name: Ghut Rak
entities.description: A Gruul guildmage.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The deity or angel Hildin serves as priest.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Guild whose legionnaire saw a noble sacrifice.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Guild whose thug saw a blazing suicide.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: Guild whose alchemist saw an experiment gone awry.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: Guild of Ravnica whose guildmage plans to attack a palace.

entities.name: Conclave
entities.description: The Selesnya Conclave, served by the children of Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: An ancient people who learned to capture mana.

entities.name: Sunbriar druids
entities.description: Druids who believe life begins in the Elderwood Scion's heart.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A world whose mages puzzled over the rings of an armillary sphere.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A city-plane where nature is reclaiming abandoned corners.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A world where everything ends up in something else's stomach.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings absent for miles in a flavor jest.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The City-Tree whose children serve the Conclave.

entities.name: Skarrg
entities.description: The Rage Pits, a Gruul palace.

entities.name: Wanderbrine
entities.description: A murky place concealing unseemly rituals among merrowkind.

entities.name: Makindi Trenches
entities.description: Trenches with outposts defended by a gomazoa.

entities.name: Great Threshold of Monserkat
entities.description: A place bearing an inscription about fallen heroes.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: A storm that shouts approval with lightning.

entities.name: Maelstrom
entities.description: A merging of shards whose mana fused into new monstrosities.

entities.name: Glen Elendra Liege
entities.description: A fae creature serving Oona.

events.summary: Asha left Bant, ensuring protection and order in her absence.
events.quote: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

events.summary: Tocasia cleared her table and began a lesson on raw elemental magic for two brothers.
events.quote: Tocasia brushed the gears and cogs from the table.

events.summary: Snukk, flung toward a target, vowed he had been tricked for the last time.
events.quote: About halfway to the target, Snukk vowed that he had been tricked for the last time.

events.summary: Edra calls for her advisors and finds them gone.
events.quote: What say you, my most trusted advisors?

events.summary: Krond lives to exact justice on his nemesis Vela.
events.quote: Krond, the personification of the dawn's light, lives to exact justice on his nemesis Vela.

events.summary: Vela snuffs out every trace of Krond's reign.
events.quote: Vela snuffs out every trace of Krond's reign, leaving pure nightfall in her wake.

events.summary: The Bant orchardist's trees were found transformed one morning.
events.quote: When we awoke, we found our trees transformed.

events.summary: Ghut Rak calls for torch-pigs to be sent against a palace.
events.quote: This palace will be our fire-spit, and roasted prince our victory meal.

events.summary: Shards merged into the Maelstrom, fusing mana into new monstrosities.
events.quote: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

relations.quote: Those who displease Oona soon learn the extent of the armies she commands.
